name: Iowa
notes: Iowa supports digital ID through the Iowa Mobile ID app as well as Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, and Samsung Wallet.

wallets.name: Apple Wallet
steps: Open the Wallet app on your iPhone (iOS 15.4 or later required).
Tap the + button and choose 'Driver's License or State ID'.
Select Iowa from the state list.
Scan the front and back of your Iowa driver's license or ID card.
Complete the face and motion scan to verify your identity.
Your request is sent to the Iowa DOT. You'll receive a notification once approved — usually within a few minutes.

wallets.name: Google Wallet
steps: Open Google Wallet on your Android device.
Tap + and select 'ID documents', then 'Driver's license or state ID'.
Choose Iowa.
Scan the front and back of your Iowa driver's license or ID.
Complete the selfie step to verify your identity.
The Iowa DOT will process and approve your digital ID within a few minutes.

wallets.name: Samsung Wallet
steps: Open Samsung Wallet on your Samsung device.
Tap + and select 'ID'.
Choose Iowa.
Scan the front and back of your Iowa driver's license or ID.
Complete the identity verification step.
The Iowa DOT will verify and approve your digital ID.

wallets.name: Iowa Mobile ID
steps: Download the Iowa Mobile ID app from the App Store or Google Play.
Create or sign in to your Iowa DOT account.
Follow the in-app prompts to scan the front and back of your Iowa driver's license or ID.
Complete the identity verification step.
Your Mobile ID will be available in the app once approved by the Iowa DOT.
